source: Generated from the Yano X repository at documentation build time.

recipes.name: Declarative event workflow
recipes.description: Compile bounded event bindings into one committed atomic composite profile.
recipes.primaryOutcome: A source command and its event-derived commands commit atomically with an auditable receipt.
recipes.firstCommand: submit a source command to the source component, then read its binding receipt
bootstrapRequirements: Pinned public member keys and normalized component configuration
recipes.trustStatement: Catalog-selected deterministic kernels; bindings do not grant authority to derived commands.

recipes.name: Replicated audit log
recipes.description: A replicated append-only log for opaque application records.
recipes.primaryOutcome: One opaque record is threshold-finalized in the shared application order.
recipes.trustStatement: First-party Yano recipe using only built-in packaged runtime capabilities.

recipes.name: Owned registry
recipes.description: A first-writer-owned key/value registry with committed query proofs.
recipes.primaryOutcome: The first writer owns a named value that is readable with a committed state proof.
recipes.verificationQuery: state/proof/{hex(key)} decodes to owner and value
recipes.trustStatement: First-party Yano recipe using the bundled standard-library registry.

recipes.name: Document trail
recipes.description: Append document hashes to a provable trail for each product, case, or shipment.
recipes.primaryOutcome: A document hash advances an entity trail; its count and head have a committed state proof.
recipes.verificationQuery: state proof for UTF8(e/<entity-id>) returns the trail count and head
recipes.trustStatement: First-party Yano recipe using the bundled standard-library registry.

recipes.name: Authenticated map
recipes.description: A proof-oriented multi-collection registry with optional canonical-CBOR and declarative schema validation.
recipes.primaryOutcome: A value accepted under a genesis-declared collection schema is committed and available with a state proof.
recipes.firstCommand: appchain inspect <app>.chain --map-genesis <chain-id> > map-genesis.hex, then appchain state validate --genesis-file map-genesis.hex ...
recipes.trustStatement: First-party Yano recipe whose collection, encoding, schema, and commitment identities are frozen in canonical genesis.

recipes.name: Threshold approval workflow
recipes.description: Validator members propose, approve, reject, and prove terminal decisions.
recipes.primaryOutcome: Distinct validator-member decisions produce a provable terminal approval or rejection.
recipes.verificationQuery: state/proof/{hex(i/itemId)} decodes to the decision trail
recipes.trustStatement: First-party Yano recipe using the bundled generic approval state machine.

recipes.name: Governed role approvals
recipes.description: Governed organizations, actors, and policies approve arbitrary application payload hashes.
recipes.primaryOutcome: A governed role policy accepts valid actor decisions and rejects an ineligible actor decision.
recipes.firstCommand: fill in <chain-id>.role-plan.yaml (written by seal beside the sealed file), run appchain role bootstrap --plan <chain-id>.role-plan.yaml once live, then submit a signed proposal
recipes.verificationQuery: plugin role-workflow proposals/{id} plus returned proof key
recipes.trustStatement: First-party generic role product; applications retain responsibility for acting on an approved payload hash.

recipes.name: Role-aware evidence ledger
recipes.description: A role-aware evidence ledger that emits publication intents; add and provision explicit connector capabilities for external mutation.
recipes.primaryOutcome: A role-authorized evidence record and its release decision are committed and queryable.
recipes.firstCommand: fill in <chain-id>.role-plan.yaml (written by seal beside the sealed file), run appchain role bootstrap --plan <chain-id>.role-plan.yaml once live, then submit evidence and a signed release proposal
recipes.trustStatement: First-party preview evidence profile; it records and authorizes evidence claims but does not prove real-world truth or external publication by itself.

recipes.name: Scalus-backed EUTxO ledger
recipes.description: A deterministic Cardano-shaped test ledger funded by an explicit virtual genesis allocation.
recipes.primaryOutcome: A signed key-controlled or bounded Plutus V3 transaction consumes virtual EUTxOs and creates MPF-proven outputs and receipts.
recipes.trustStatement: Experimental no-real-funds recipe; bounded Plutus V3 execution does not make it a Cardano bridge, custody product, or rollup.

recipes.name: Federated Cardano EUTxO bridge
recipes.description: A Cardano-backed EUTxO ledger with stable deposits and claim-bound federated withdrawals through external signing or permissionless current-root proofs.
recipes.primaryOutcome: Accepted stable deposits create mirrored EUTxOs; signed L2 spends create irrevocable claims that settle only through the configured signer path or a current accepted MPF root with single-use nullification.
recipes.firstCommand: stage and accept a bounded deposit, then submit a signed withdrawal output carrying the bridge withdrawal datum
recipes.verificationQuery: query bridge/deposits/record, bridge/withdrawals/record, bridge/reserve, and the root-fixed withdrawal commitment proof through appchain-eutxo-client
recipes.trustStatement: Experimental real-funds federated custody path. Use only reviewed contract identities and bridge/root operators. Signer mode trusts an external threshold/HSM; proof mode trusts the threshold-accepted root. Virtual genesis is deliberately excluded.

recipes.name: Custom state-machine project
recipes.description: A chain that runs a separately reviewed custom state-machine plugin, named by the stateMachine answer and pinned by digest at seal.
recipes.primaryOutcome: The operator-defined state-machine contract is loaded from a reviewed pinned plugin bundle.
recipes.firstCommand: copy the reviewed bundle into plugins/ on every node before seal, then submit its documented command
recipes.verificationQuery: plugin-defined committed query or state proof
recipes.trustStatement: Advanced JVM-only path; the operator owns plugin implementation, code review, metadata trust, compatibility, and distribution.

capabilities.name: Threshold approval workflow

capabilities.name: Member balances

capabilities.name: Document trail

capabilities.name: Evidence registry

capabilities.name: Role-gated payload approvals

capabilities.name: Role-aware evidence workflow
capabilities.description: Evidence registration combined with governed domain actors and role-aware release approval.

capabilities.name: Custom JVM plugin state machine
capabilities.description: Runs a separately reviewed custom state-machine bundle that every operator installs and seal pins by digest.

capabilities.name: Scalus-backed EUTxO ledger engine
capabilities.description: Deterministic Cardano-shaped EUTxO state, root-fixed receipts, address indexes, and MPF-proven outputs under one explicitly selected ledger profile.

capabilities.name: Bounded EUTxO Plutus V3 profile
capabilities.description: Pins the immutable yano-eutxo-v2-plutus-v3 ledger profile and every consensus-relevant bound.

capabilities.name: Governed bridge-settlement EUTxO profile
capabilities.description: Pins the immutable yano-eutxo-v3-bridge-settlement ledger profile (ADR-UTXO-009) and every consensus-relevant bound.

capabilities.name: Restricted EUTxO key-payment profile
capabilities.description: Pins the immutable yano-eutxo-v1 key-payments ledger profile.

capabilities.name: Virtual EUTxO genesis allocation
capabilities.description: Bootstraps one explicit ADA-only virtual allocation for no-real-funds testing.

capabilities.name: Federated Cardano EUTxO bridge
capabilities.description: Observes exact accepted vault deposits and settles irrevocable bounded claims through either exact external signing or permissionless current-root MPF proofs with an on-chain replay nullifier.

capabilities.name: EUTxO lifecycle indexer
capabilities.description: Indexes finalized EUTxO transactions, accounts, bridge lifecycle records, and optional validity batches for bounded APIs and the unified console.

capabilities.name: Fixed sequencer
capabilities.description: One declared member proposes application blocks.

capabilities.name: L1-window rotating sequencer
capabilities.description: Rotates proposership across members using bounded L1 slot windows.

capabilities.name: Static membership
capabilities.description: Pins the initial member set as the active set.

capabilities.name: Governed membership
capabilities.description: Allows authenticated member epochs to evolve through replicated governance.

capabilities.name: L1 slot feed
capabilities.description: Supplies stable local Cardano slot observations to slot-aware app-chain behavior.

capabilities.name: Cardano metadata anchors
capabilities.description: Commits finalized app-chain roots in Cardano transaction metadata.

capabilities.name: Cardano threshold-script anchors
capabilities.description: Advances an app-chain anchor thread through a reviewed Cardano script.

capabilities.name: Address deposit observer
capabilities.description: Creates stable observations for lovelace paid to one configured Cardano address.

capabilities.name: Metadata label observer
capabilities.description: Creates stable observations for one configured Cardano transaction metadata label.

capabilities.name: Deterministic effects runtime
capabilities.description: Enables deterministic effect intents, gates, result incorporation, and proofs.

capabilities.name: Generic on-approved effect
capabilities.description: Emits one typed chain-result effect when a stock approval reaches its threshold.

capabilities.name: Webhook effect executor
capabilities.description: Executes webhook.post effects against one node-local configured URL.

capabilities.name: Finalized webhook sink
capabilities.description: Posts finalized application blocks to one configured node-local webhook endpoint.

capabilities.name: Kafka effect executor
capabilities.description: Executes kafka.publish intents through allowlisted node-local Kafka targets.

capabilities.name: Kafka finalized sink
capabilities.description: Publishes finalized application blocks to a configured Kafka topic.

capabilities.name: S3-compatible object executor
capabilities.description: Executes immutable object.put promotion against allowlisted S3-compatible targets.

capabilities.name: IPFS pin executor
capabilities.description: Executes reconciled ipfs.pin intents against allowlisted Kubo targets.

capabilities.name: Cardano payment executor
capabilities.description: Executes bounded cardano.payment intents from an operator-controlled payer wallet.

capabilities.name: Composite state-machine framework
capabilities.description: Deterministic component, workflow, profile, query, quota, and profile-governance framework.

capabilities.name: Embedded node console
capabilities.description: Embedded operational app-chain status console derived from the selected Yano distribution.

capabilities.name: Prometheus observability companion
capabilities.description: Optional one-command durable metrics history for the unified console.
